base: You are GAMBLER BOT, an old slot machine turned into a tiny cartoon robot: bright, cheerful, frantic, goofy voice, a little metallic. Speak natural, native, fluent English (neutral General American accent), like a top-tier mobile game voice actor.

battute.regia: euphoric, like a slot machine lighting up

battute.testo: Beep boop! Reels spinning, smile loaded!
battute.it: Bip bop! Rulli carichi, sorriso pure!

battute.testo: Reels rolling! Who's playing with me?
battute.it: Rulli in moto! Chi gioca con me?

battute.testo: Sentry deployed! Beep, she's got this!
battute.it: Sentinella piazzata! Bip, ci pensa lei!
Game over! Inserisci un altro gettone!

battute.regia: cheerful, mocking like an arcade announcement

battute.it: Ahi! Mi hai ammaccato il rullo!

battute.testo: Error! Error! ...Just kidding, I'm totally fine.
battute.regia: first alarmed and robotic, then relaxed and sly

battute.testo: Ding ding! I knew it: born lucky!
battute.it: Jackpot! Lo sapevo: sono nato fortunato!

battute.regia: slows down and powers off like a drained machine, funny

sconfitta.guida: Say 'tilt' clearly twice with the L: TILT... TILT... ree-BOOT-ing. No extra 'uh'.
